# Open a camt.053 or MT940 bank statement and check it adds up

> Free camt.053 and MT940 bank statement reader: see balances and entries as a table, check that opening balance plus entries equals the closing balance, catch duplicates and gaps, and download a CSV. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/eu-bank-statement-reader/)

## Source

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/eu-bank-statement-reader): FSL-1.1-MIT licensed.

## What it reads

- camt.053, camt.052 and camt.054 XML; MT940 text, including files that hold several SWIFT messages (`{1:}{2:}{4:` ... `-}`), each read as its own statement.
- Its MT940 reading is checked against two other MT940 readers in the same repository by a differential fuzzer (`mt940-differential.mjs`).
